name: manual_22f546
claim: Fold another agent's already-pushed branch that has no PR into the consolidated PR only after four checks: its own changes by three-dot diff, that the files are really absent from main, a clean trial merge, and the tests; replay the commits onto the consolidated branch and leave the old branch alone.
conditions: consolidate other agent branch no pr trial merge three-dot replay

decisions.notes: 2026-11-26: a six-commit steipete branch pushed without a PR was new, merged cleanly in a trial merge and was replayed onto the consolidated orama draft after the checks.

rationale: 2026-11-26: a six-commit steipete branch pushed without a PR was new, merged cleanly in a trial merge and was replayed onto the consolidated orama draft after the checks.
